items.q: Which insurance companies does Siva Kumar work with?
items.a: Siva Kumar provides insurance agency assistance representing Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) for life insurance, The New India Assurance Co. Ltd. for general insurance, and Star Health and Allied Insurance for health insurance.

items.q: Where are insurance assistance services available?
items.a: Insurance assistance services are primarily provided for customers residing in Hosur and surrounding areas, allowing for direct, personalized coordination.

items.q: Can I enquire about a new insurance policy?
items.a: Yes. You can enquire about new life, health, motor, or property insurance policies. Siva Kumar will discuss suitable options and explain terms before assisting you with the official insurer application.

items.q: Can existing policyholders receive renewal assistance?
items.a: Yes. Existing policyholders of LIC, New India Assurance, and Star Health Insurance can receive assistance with renewal premium payments and official receipt generation.

items.q: Can I request assistance with an insurance claim?
items.a: Yes. We assist policyholders with understanding required claim documents, completing forms, and submitting them through the appropriate official insurer procedures. Final claim decisions and settlements rest entirely with the respective insurance company.

All insurance applications and premium payments are processed directly through the respective official insurance company portals. SIVA INSURANCES & GRANITE SERVICES does not collect or hold premium funds directly.

items.q: Can I request assistance with policy information updates?
items.a: Yes. We help policyholders prepare and submit official requests for contact updates, address changes, and nominee modifications to their respective insurance company.

sqftGuide.heading: How Much Granite Do You Need?
sqftGuide.subtitle: Understanding square-foot requirements to receive accurate quotations and avoid material shortfalls.
sqftGuide.method1Title: Method 1 – Customer Already Knows the Quantity
sqftGuide.method1Desc: Some customers or contractors already have architectural drawings or measured takeoffs with an exact square footage requirement.
sqftGuide.method1Example: Required area: 500 sq. ft. You can directly share this quantity on our enquiry form for immediate quotation coordination.
sqftGuide.method2Desc: If you need help determining the required area, calculate each room or surface using basic length and width dimensions:
sqftGuide.method2Example: Length = 20 ft, Width = 15 ft → Area = 300 sq. ft. For multiple rooms or staircases, each area can be calculated separately and combined.
sqftGuide.wastageNoticeTitle: Important Note on Cutting, Layout & Wastage Allowance
sqftGuide.wastageNoticeDesc: Actual material requirements may differ from simple mathematical area due to slab cutting, edge profiling, pattern matching, breakage margin, and installation layout. The final purchase quantity should always be verified with your contractor, installer, and supplier before placing an order.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear, straightforward answers about exploring, selecting, and purchasing granite through Siva Granites.

items.q: Where can I explore granite varieties?
items.a: Siva Kumar coordinates with approximately 20–25 granite companies and showrooms in Hosur, giving you access to view a wide range of natural stone varieties, colours, and finishes in one central hub.

items.q: Do you serve customers outside Hosur?
items.a: Yes. Granite coordination services are available to customers across Tamil Nadu. We coordinate direct transportation from Hosur to your project site, subject to supplier and transport arrangements.

items.q: Can I request a quotation based on square feet?
items.a: Yes. Customers can share their required area in square feet. Siva Kumar will coordinate with suppliers to obtain competitive, transparent per-square-foot quotations based on your chosen stone and finish.

items.q: What if I don't know the required square footage?
items.a: If you don't know the exact square footage, you can share room dimensions (length and width) or architectural plans. We assist in understanding the calculations and estimating the required quantity including cutting allowances.

items.q: Can I compare different granite varieties?
items.a: Yes. Personal assistance is provided to help you explore and compare different varieties in terms of colour consistency, mineral patterns, durability, surface finishes (polished, leather, flamed, honed), and price points.

Transportation is coordinated based on your delivery location, the supplier's dispatch point, and order volume. We coordinate with reliable logistics providers to ensure safe transport from Hosur to your site.

items.q: How does the payment process work?
items.a: Payment arrangements depend on the individual supplier and order requirements. The applicable payment terms, advance conditions, and delivery schedules will be explained transparently before you confirm your order.

items.q: Can I visit granite companies with Siva Kumar?
items.a: Yes. Showroom and yard visits in Hosur can be coordinated based on customer requirements and supplier arrangements, allowing you to inspect actual stone slabs before purchase.

finishesSection.heading: Understanding Surface Finishes
finishesSection.subtitle: Natural granite can be crafted with distinct surface treatments, each offering different visual sheen, tactile textures, and slip resistance.
finishesSection.note: Note: Not every granite variety is available in every finish. Specific finish availability depends on natural stone density and supplier processing lines.

items.name: Polished Finish
items.desc: Diamond-polished to a high mirror shine that accentuates deep crystal reflections and natural stone color depth.
items.usage: Recommended for kitchen countertops, dining tables, interior flooring, and luxury feature walls.

items.name: Leather / Antique Finish
items.desc: Brushed with diamond abrasive brushes to produce a subtle undulating, leather-like texture that conceals smudges and fingerprints.
items.usage: Popular for modern kitchen islands, bathroom vanities, bar counters, and low-glare accent spaces.

items.name: Flamed Finish
items.desc: Heat-treated with intense torches to fracture surface quartz crystals, creating a rough, weathered, non-slip textured face.
items.usage: Essential for exterior paving, outdoor staircases, ramps, swimming pool decks, and garden pathways.

items.name: Honed Finish
items.desc: Precision-ground to a flat, velvety satin matte surface without high-gloss reflections, offering subtle modern sophistication.
items.usage: Well-suited for high-traffic commercial foyers, contemporary residential floors, and minimalist wall cladding.
